description: v4 hull; user verified external dimensions and 14-inch outer chine beam. Equivalent-hull estimates only.

beam_m.meaning: Outer transom chine-to-chine beam: 14 in; includes both reverse-chine strips, not overall width.

mass_kg.meaning: Sum of supplied nonblank component masses: 125.107 lb.

deadrise_deg.meaning: 20-degree main-panel angle at transom, used as a constant-V approximation; outer-chine chord comparison is separate.

lcg_m.meaning: Mass-weighted CG: 23.7342543343 in forward of transom (CAD Y).

vcg_m.meaning: Mass-weighted CG: 6.02353554158 in above aft keel (CAD Z).

thrust_height_m.meaning: Point on shaft line, above keel; negative = below datum

thrust_x_m.meaning: Point on shaft line, forward of transom; negative = aft

thrust_angle_deg.meaning: Upward forward thrust angle relative to keel

roughness_m.meaning: Zero = smooth-hull assumption, disables roughness allowance

wetted_lengths_type.meaning: 2 = Savitsky 1964; this notebook supports only this geometry

flap_chord_m.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

flap_span_ratio.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

flap_angle_deg.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

geometry_warning: Reverse-chine strips, changing chine beam and keel rocker; no uniform aft length established. Constant-V equivalent-hull estimate only.
assumptions: Outer transom chine-to-chine beam b=14 in; overall maximum width is not used as b.
Main V panel is 20 degrees at transom; comparison uses the 18.358212-degree keel-to-outer-chine chord.
The constant-V model does not explicitly represent reverse-chine lift/drag or varying sections and rocker.
No uniform aft region has been established; geometry_ok is false at every solved speed.
Loading uses only supplied nonblank masses; no missing component masses are estimated.
CG coordinates use CAD Y forward from transom and Z above aft keel; small transverse CG offset is ignored by symmetric model.
User requested previous two-prop thrust line: 15 degrees, same signed point coordinates relative to aft keel/transom.
Freshwater at 20 C: density 998.2 kg/m3, viscosity 1.004e-6 m2/s; smooth-hull roughness allowance disabled.
Effective power is horizontal resistance times speed, not motor or battery power.
No displacement/transition resistance, appendages, air drag, waves, propeller interaction or dynamic-stability model.
Cv<1 is an evaluation cutoff, not planing onset.
